title: Restore offline standalone harness scorecard parity
goal: Vision: V-6. Preserve the existing public scorecard APIs and installed command when no provider is configured, retain typed failures and explicit provider routing, and qualify old and paired installations. Keep the full socket ceiling binding.

reuse.searched: Restore the public Apache scorer from fdef8913e for standalone profiles. Reuse the typed provider session and bounded Git runner, and share existing pillar startup, reply, and plane bus behavior to preserve the runtime ceiling.
